The '''1956–57 season of the [[Eredivisie]]''' was the first edition of a national professional men's football team competition in the [[Football in the Netherlands|Netherlands]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.eredivisie.nl/subpage.aspx?l1=1667&l2=1668|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20071008130800/http://www.eredivisie.nl/subpage.aspx?l1=1667&l2=1668|url-status=dead|title=De officiële website van Eredivisie - Historie|archive-date=October 8, 2007|website=Eredivisie.nl|access-date=July 31, 2026}}</ref> It was contested by 18 teams, and [[AFC Ajax|Ajax]] won the championship.
